verdict: Paid campaigns are paused; organic traffic is the only active channel.
narrative: No paid spend ran across Meta or Google this period, which means no paid leads were generated. Website traffic came entirely from organic sources — 188 sessions from 150 visitors over the last 28 days — but the most recent days show that momentum softening rather than building. Google Business Profile activity has also gone quiet in the last three days after modest engagement earlier in the period. Conversion tracking is being reviewed, so the zero conversions recorded in website analytics likely under-reports actual contact activity. Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority to restore lead flow.

highlights.phrase: paid spend across all 28 days — no paid leads were generated this period
website sessions this period, all from organic sources
Google Business Profile actions this period, including 33 direction requests and 1 call

watch_item.issue: Paid campaigns on Meta and Google have been inactive the full 28-day window, halting lead generation.
watch_item.fix: Reactivating paid campaigns is the current focus; once live, lead flow and cost per lead will be reportable again.
